This is a live performance video of the 2026 Baekseok Arts University Applied Music Department Vocal major acceptance.

Hello! This is Vocal Friends.

This is a live video of Jeong Yeon-jae, who was accepted to the Baekseok Arts University Applied Music Department Vocal major through rolling admissions.

Yeonjae, a con artist with precise pitch, solid fundamentals, songwriting skills, and even guitar playing, 😎
Her fundamental skills were evident from the first time we met her in March 2025.
But because she possessed such a wide range of abilities,
her unique strengths, like "Yeonjae's secret weapon," weren't particularly prominent, which led to her many concerns. 🤔

This is perhaps a common concern among college applicants.

Before even understanding a song, students blindly copied it,
or without even being informed of their strengths,
preparing for the entrance exam through a one-sided, spoon-fed approach.

Naturally, students tend to be passive,
and that's where Yeonjae's concerns began. ❗️

Through weekly performance classes,
I realized that Yeonjae's most sparkling moments on stage
were when she sang songs with the "fun elements" she loved.

As Yeonjae began to enjoy singing,

she began to develop her own unique style. The skills she had previously possessed are beginning to shine 🤩

We look forward to sharing the joy and happiness Yeonjae feels through music
on a bigger stage, with more people, and we ask for your continued support.
